faq.q: Which Ladner sub-areas appear in the under-$1.8M detached band?
faq.a: On the page text read for this file, the feed's cards are labelled Port Guichon, Delta Manor, Hawthorne, Ladner Elementary and Holly — the established Ladner sub-areas; the page's own copy names the same five as the band's core.

faq.q: Can a first-time buyer use the PTT exemption on a Ladner home under $1.8M?
faq.a: Only at the band's very bottom: the first time home buyers' program's full exemption runs to a fair market value of $835,000 (exempting the first $500,000 of price), with a partial exemption only below $860,000 — above that, the program does not apply at all, subject always to the program's other conditions.

faq.q: Can a Ladner home under $1.8M add a suite or other units?
faq.a: The official framework is Delta's SSMUH zoning updates, which allow up to four units on all single-detached and duplex lots, with City support for coach houses, garden suites and secondary suites — what a specific lot can build is a parcel-level City check, not a band-wide guarantee.

faq.q: Which schools serve Ladner's detached neighbourhoods?
faq.a: School District 37, address-based. The schools physically in Ladner on the BC Ministry list are Ladner Elementary (5016 44 Ave), Hawthorne Elementary (5160 Central Ave), Holly Elementary (4625 62 St), Port Guichon Elementary (4381 46a St), Neilson Grove Elementary (5500 Admiral Blvd) and Delta Secondary (4615 51 St). Check the exact address in the SD37 School Locator — catchments are not assigned by sub-area name.
